Include a wide range of contexts such as online reviews, customer support interactions, social media comments, and in-person feedback. Use varied tones (e.g., enthusiastic, grateful, casual, professional) and mention specific aspects like product features, delivery speed, pricing, or staff friendliness. Incorporate subtle nuances, such as mild praise or constructive suggestions alongside positivity, to mimic real-world feedback. Include cultural or regional language variations (e.g., slang, formalities) and domain-specific terms (e.g., tech, retail, hospitality). Ensure text length varies from concise one-liners to detailed multi-sentence reviews.
